zh.title: 美國航空一週接收4架空中巴士新機、含1架A321XLR
zh.summary: 美國航空在一週內接收3架A321neo與1架A321XLR，年底前還將再接收4架空中巴士新機，下一代A321機隊規模已達100架。
body: 美國航空在一週內接收4架空中巴士新機，包括3架A321neo與1架A321XLR，其中註冊編號N311NY的A321XLR預定10月30日抵達，交付航程目的地為達拉斯沃斯堡國際機場，該機在漢堡製造。美國航空年底前還將再接收4架空中巴士新機，包括3架A321neo與1架A321XLR，今年內不再排定接收其他波音新機。

這批交付使美國航空下一代A321機隊達到100架，另有218架A321-200，其中11架為A321XLR。美國航空於2025年10月接收首架A321XLR，成為美國首家營運該機型的業者，原訂50架的承諾已降至40架，2025年底前交付5架。A321XLR設20席旗艦套房商務艙、12席高級經濟艙與123席經濟艙，共155席，美國航空表示該機型正在改變其國際航網，適合以較小機型開拓較薄的跨大西洋航線。

en.title: American Airlines takes delivery of four new Airbus A321neos in one week
en.summary: American Airlines has taken delivery of three Airbus A321neos and one A321XLR in seven days, with four more Airbus deliveries expected before the end of 2026, taking its next-generation A321 fleet to 100 aircraft.
body: American Airlines is accelerating its fleet modernisation, taking delivery of four new Airbus aircraft in just seven days. The arrivals comprise three Airbus A321neos and one Airbus A321XLR, with the latter, registered N311NY, scheduled to arrive on October 30. FlightRadar24 data cited in the report shows the Hamburg-built XLR touching down on its delivery flight to Dallas/Fort Worth International Airport, joining three standard A321neos delivered earlier in the week. The airline expects another four Airbus deliveries before the end of 2026, including three A321neos and an additional A321XLR, and no additional Boeing aircraft are scheduled to arrive this year.

The deliveries have taken American Airlines to 100 next-generation A321s in operation, alongside 218 A321-200s, of which 11 are XLRs. American received its first A321XLR in October 2025, becoming the first US operator of the type; its original 50-aircraft commitment was subsequently reduced to 40, including five delivered by the end of 2025. Each XLR features 20 Flagship Suite business class seats, 12 premium economy seats and 123 economy seats, for 155 seats in total, and the type is presented as transforming American's international network by making thinner transatlantic routes viable without deploying a much larger Boeing 787.
